purpose: 18 structured intents (intake, triage assist, handoff, EMS pre-arrival risk, bottlenecks, etc.) implemented as pure rule/heuristic handlers with mandatory clinician review.
trainingDataLineage: No ML training. Logic in lib/ai/careDroidAI.ts handlers; prompts in careDroidAIPrompts.ts for documentation/persona only.
limitations: Confidence scores are heuristic, not calibrated model uncertainty.

deployment.rollback: Disable structured AI node routes / feature flags at API gateway; retain deterministic calculators and ops dashboards.

history.note: Provenance contract attached to all success/error responses.

retirementPlan: Replace individual intents with measured tools+RAG only when eval residual gap is proven; retire intents one-by-one with registry entries.
